item.title: Impulse returns to World Championships in 2027; Blue Knights bring back the cymbal line
item.description:
DCI's latest corps news roundup leads with Impulse returning to the World Championships in 2027, a notable comeback for the corps. Meanwhile, the Blue Knights will field their first cymbal line since 1998 — a throwback that longtime drum corps fans will appreciate.

Also in the roundup: Northern Lights unveiled a new logo, and there are updates from DCI All-Age and SoundSport. It's a quiet offseason news day overall, but the Impulse return and the Blue Knights' cymbal line revival are the items worth knowing as corps start gearing up for next summer.

item.title: The road to DCI 2027 starts now: key dates to circle
item.description:
It's been a little over three months since the final moments of the 2026 Drum Corps International Tour sounded off, but the first signs of the 2027 season are already here. DCI has laid out the key dates to circle on the road to #DCI2027, giving fans, performers, and corps staff the milestones to watch as the new season takes shape.

For a community that lives on the summer tour calendar, the offseason dates matter: auditions, show announcements, and tour stops all build toward next summer, and the first markers of the 2027 season are now on the board.

item.title: Suncoast Sound alumni launch a foundation to support today's performers
item.description:
Decades after their final notes resonated across the football field, the spirit of Suncoast Sound is preparing to make a lasting impact on the modern drum corps community. Former members have launched a new Suncoast Sound Alumni Foundation, aimed at giving back to today's performers.

Alumni foundations have become an important way for legacy corps to support the next generation — funding scholarships, instruments, and opportunities for young marchers who might otherwise never get the chance. The Suncoast Sound alumni are now joining that tradition, turning decades-old memories into real support for the performers on the field today.
